implementation: Real Prep Manager (ported from Round 2 OpsConsole). AI-observes/rules-decide: Gemini vision describes what is visible, a deterministic engine emits PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN per FBA prep clause (rules.py). One batched model call per unit; fails open to UNCERTAIN when vision is unavailable.
notes: In-process Python port. Set GEMINI_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY) for live vision; without a key the agent still runs and returns honest UNCERTAIN records. Optional PREP_MODEL env overrides the Gemini model (default gemini-2.5-flash).
